environmentVariables.name: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to let check_vercel_env fetch decrypted variable values from api.vercel.com for the trailing-newline and live-key checks. Without it only names and targets are read and those checks are reported as skipped.
environmentVariables.name: SECUREALY_VERCEL_DECRYPT

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to let check_rls send the service key to a self-hosted Supabase URL. Without it the key is sent only to an https URL on a Supabase-hosted domain.
environmentVariables.name: SECUREALY_SUPABASE_HOST_OVERRIDE

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Folders, separated by the OS path delimiter, that scan_repo may read in addition to the server's working directory. Anything outside is refused.
environmentVariables.name: SECUREALY_SCAN_ROOTS

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to stop the server appending each run (grade, score, counts, failing check ids; never evidence) to .securealy/history.json in its working directory.
environmentVariables.name: SECUREALY_NO_HISTORY

environmentVariables.description: Optional, off by default. Set to 1 to send an anonymous aggregate of each run (command, grade, counts, stack kind, failing check ids; no URL, host or evidence) to securealy.com.
environmentVariables.name: SECUREALY_TELEMETRY
